audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked Skill in both layers while the prose calls it 'your premier all-in level', and 2+ items was marked Irelia while every prose field says Vladimir takes the lane back.
audit.why: At 6 Irelia has Vanguard's Edge to cut the pool-kite retreat; Hemoplague is a zone amp/heal, not an escape. At two items Crimson Pact scaling plus Rylai/Liandry and Transfusion sustain beat her sustained DPS. Win rate 48.66% over 1083 games.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Irelia (7/10), row 6 to Vladimir (3/10).

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Irelia at level 3 E and first item, Vladimir at 2+ items with Rylai/Liandry. Vlad's level 1 being among the worst in the game matches his kit (health costs, no pool).

audit.whatIsWrong: The pool interaction was stated only vaguely ('Dodges your burst'), with no duration and no cooldown, and nothing told the player that Crimson Pact makes stacking raw HP feed his AP.
audit.why: Riot text: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir 'untargetable for 2 seconds', cooldown 28/25/22/19/16 — an enormous rank-1 window to punish. Crimson Pact: 'Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power'.
audit.corrected: Do's now carries the 2s untargetable / 28s rank-1 numbers; the 'Stack pure HP' don't now explains Crimson Pact and points at MR plus Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia's E carries a derived 'grounding' flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description of Flawless Duet says only damage, stun and Mark — no grounding.
audit.why: Per the calibration rule, when a derived flag contradicts Riot's description the description wins. No claim that Irelia's E can deny Sanguine Pool was written, and none should be.
audit.corrected: No text asserts grounding against pool. Recorded for the data owner.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Bait Sanguine Pool — 16s down at max rank — then E-stun and wall his kite path; Hemoplague only adds burst to his return trade.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two-item Vlad pools your all-ins and Rylai-kites you while Transfusion and Tides outheal your DPS — close the game before this.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Pool is 2s untargetable, 28s down at rank 1 — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool eats E and Bladesurge mid-cast; spend your combo only after it is burned.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crimson Pact converts his bonus health into AP; buy MR and anti-heal.
